title: Entrance examinations
summary: Examination list, minimum scores and examination programmes.

body.text: The entrance examinations depend on the chosen programme. School leavers usually submit Unified State Exam results; vocational and university graduates may take internal exams.

items: On each programme card in the catalogue.

body.title: Minimum scores
body.text: Minimum scores are set annually by the admissions office and published before applications open.
